mapper.select: SELECT FROM data_archive_job WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM data_archive_job WHERE owner_id=#{owner} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_archive_job WHERE owner_id=#{owner}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_archive_job WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
SELECT FROM data_archive_job WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND state='QUEUED' AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE data_archive_job SET state='RUNNING',started_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND state='QUEUED' AND expires_at>#{now}
UPDATE data_archive_job SET state='FAILED',completed_at=#{now},error_code=#{code} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND state='RUNNING'
UPDATE data_archive_job SET state='FAILED',completed_at=#{now},error_code='ARCHIVE_INTERRUPTED' WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND state='RUNNING' AND started_at<#{before}
UPDATE data_archive_job SET state='EXPIRED' WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND state IN ('QUEUED','READY') AND expires_at<=#{now}
